notebooks.execution_method: nbclient clean Python 3.12 kernel, all 25 cells in order, GitHub Actions Ubuntu 24.04 and Java 21. All user-relevant outputs retained. The final run reuses checksum-verified OPM SMSPEC/UNSMRY outputs from 29 successful native OPM solves; native NeqSim transport and process calculations, ML fitting and all report-time checks are rerun. No reservoir proxy fallback or fabricated simulator result is used.

rendered_visual_validation.renderer: nbconvert HTML, MathJax, Playwright Chromium, 1440px viewport
rendered_visual_validation.notes: Inspected every Markdown and result-bearing cell. Corrected a pressure-reference definition, overlapping feedback-arrow label, clipped tables and diagnostics, and decision-map contrast; reran and inspected the corrected rendering.

notebooks.issue_handling: An explicit audited outlet TP/property refresh works around the invalid connected outlet property state. Phase-flux deficits, pressure floors and failed convergence are rejected, retained with inputs, and never promoted to feasible solutions. No core NeqSim fix or qualified field-design claim is made.
notebooks.documentation_impact: New detailed teaching notebook and reproducible validation workflow; README and example-book links added, maintenance count and dedicated shard updated. The earlier FMU/Norne notebook is preserved.
